name: fdic-banking
title: US bank totals by year and state, 1934 to 2025
summary: Bank analysis on the FDIC's public yearly totals for insured banks: profitability, capital, funding, loan quality, growth, consolidation, state rankings, and checks of the tables against themselves.
description: Each task gives the AI real yearly totals for FDIC-insured institutions, by year, state and charter class, with the FDIC's own definition of every field. The question states the years and the formula of every ratio it asks for, and the AI gives exact figures: a ratio, a growth rate, a ranking, a count, or whether the tables agree with themselves. Every field of the answer is checked, and a task passes only when all of them are right.

families.name: Profitability
families.what: Return on assets and on equity, with balances averaged as the question says.

families.name: Capital
families.what: Equity and tangible equity to assets, and dividends against earnings.

families.name: Funding and liquidity
families.what: Loans to deposits, the mix of deposits, and where new deposits went.

families.name: Income structure
families.what: Net interest and noninterest income, the efficiency ratio and the net interest margin.

families.name: Asset quality
families.what: Past-due and noncurrent loans, charge-offs, provisions and the allowance.

families.name: Growth
families.what: Year-on-year and compound growth rates over the spans the question states.

families.name: Consolidation
families.what: The numbers of banks, branches and offices over time and by state.

families.name: Charter comparison
families.what: Commercial banks against savings institutions, adding the two charter classes up or keeping them apart as asked.

families.name: State rankings
families.what: States ranked by assets, deposits or return, and their shares of the national total, with no totals row counted as a state.

families.name: Data check
families.what: Whether the rows and fields add up and tie out, and which breaks are real and which rows only look wrong.
